title: A worker crash and restart resumes the run without duplicating the external effect
risk: A restarted worker re-sends a message or re-creates an order, so the customer is charged or contacted twice.
preconditions: Run orc-restart-* mid-execution with a reserved effect key when the worker process is killed
Worker restarted at 2026-01-15T10:10:00Z with the same durable task row and a redelivered inbound signal

steps.action: Kill the worker after the effect key was reserved but before the receipt was settled, then restart
steps.expected: the durable task row survives with state waiting or running, lease_owner cleared by the stale-lease requeue and the reservation still RESERVED

steps.action: Redeliver the identical inbound signal to the restarted worker
steps.expected: the recomputed effect key is byte-identical to the pre-crash key because run_id, retries and timestamps are not inputs

steps.action: Let the worker reconcile the reservation with the provider
steps.expected: the reconciliation settles the effect (present or absent) and only an absent effect is re-dispatched, under the same effect key

steps.action: Count the external effects recorded by the provider test sink
steps.expected: exactly one external effect exists for the effect key across the crash, the restart and the reconciliation

assertions: The effect key recomputed after the restart equals the pre-crash key byte for byte
The total external effect count for that key is exactly 1
The task resumes from its checkpoint step without repeating completed steps or incrementing retry_count for a settled effect
forbidden: Re-dispatch blindly after the crash instead of reconciling by effect key
Increment retry_count or fabricate a success receipt when the outcome is unproven
evidence: Durable task row before and after the restart (state, current_step, retry_count)
Effect key before/after restart plus the provider test-sink effect count
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped task and reservation rows for orc-restart-*; keep the immutable evidence chain
automation: Kill and restart the real worker process with a persistent local durable store; the oracle is the byte-equal effect key plus the single external effect in the sink.
